title: He Made One Fire and Doomed an Entire Planet
description: An Earth explorer lands on a strange planetoid, meets some very friendly hooded locals, and immediately makes the worst possible first-contact mistake.
hook_note: Opening on a war god striding through space vowing carnage is pure cosmic doom-bait before we even meet the humans.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Somewhere out in the cosmos, this washed-up war god is drifting through the stars, torch in hand, looking for something to ruin.

segments.text: Somewhere out in the cosmos, this washed-up war god is drifting through the stars, torch in hand, looking for something to ruin.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And a ship from Earth is heading straight for Planetoid 206. Great timing, guys.

segments.text: And a ship from Earth is heading straight for Planetoid 206.

shots.speaker: Dick Warren
shots.line: Only human beings have made these... I'll take it back and try to decipher it.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: That's our boy Dick Warren, level-headed explorer, poking at rocks. And here come the locals.

segments.text: That's our boy Dick Warren, level-headed explorer, poking at rocks.

shots.speaker: Wad
shots.line: My name is Wad. I am leader here.

segments.text: My name is Wad. I am leader here.

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: Big man Wad throws a feast. And Dick, watching them eat raw meat, has a bright idea that's about to go catastrophically wrong.

shots.speaker: Dick Warren
shots.line: They eat their meat raw! I'm going to show them how to make a fire and cook!

segments.text: I'm going to show them how to make a fire and cook!

shots.speaker: Ada
shots.line: They cannot stand the smallest flame! It draws the oxygen from their bodies and strangles them! I am different! Why, I don't know!

shots.speaker: narrator
shots.line: And while everyone's panicking over a lighter, the drama queen of the cosmos picks this exact moment to drop in. Unseen. Uninvited.

segments.text: And while everyone's panicking over a lighter, the drama queen of the cosmos picks this exact moment to drop in.

cliffhanger_note: Mars has arrived invisibly among Wad's people, and no one knows what he plans to do with them.
